properties.name: accept
properties.desc: Comma-separated types or extensions, in the form `<input accept>` takes.

properties.name: attachments
properties.desc: The staged files, in the order they arrived.

properties.name: files
properties.desc: Just the files, for building a request body.

properties.name: maxCount
properties.desc: Most files that may be staged at once; unlimited when unset.

properties.name: maxSize
properties.desc: Largest file accepted, in bytes.

properties.name: disabled
properties.desc: Blocks clicks and keyboard activation and removes the button from the tab order. Off by default; `disabled="false"` counts as enabled.

properties.name: effect
properties.desc: Whether the click ripple is drawn. On by default; opt out with `effect="false"`.

properties.name: icon
properties.desc: Name of an `<r-icon>` drawn before the label, for example `'search'`. No icon when empty.

properties.name: iconSize
properties.desc: Icon size passed to the inner `<r-icon>`. Defaults to about 1.15× the button's font size; set it only when the icon needs a fixed size.

properties.name: type
properties.desc: Visual variant: `''` (default) | `'primary'` (monochrome) | `'warning'` | `'text'`. Drives the `:host([type=...])` styles.

properties.name: description
properties.desc: Secondary text shown under the heading. Empty by default; the header is hidden when the heading, description and `extra` slot are all empty.

properties.name: heading
properties.desc: Heading text.

properties.name: hoverable
properties.desc: Interactive card (Geist): hover darkens the border one step. Purely presentational — gate it to cards that are actually clickable.

properties.name: alphaLabel

properties.name: disabled

properties.name: hueLabel
properties.desc: Accessible name of the hue slider.

properties.name: label
properties.desc: Accessible name of the swatch that opens the picker. Defaults to `'Choose color'`.

properties.name: value
properties.desc: Selected colour as `#rrggbb` (or `#rgb`), `rgb(...)` or `rgba(...)`; picking a colour writes a hex value, or `rgba(...)` when opacity is below 1. Unparseable values are ignored. Empty until set; the swatch starts white.

properties.name: empty
properties.desc: Text shown while the projection has produced no rows.

properties.name: follow
properties.desc: Whether new content is followed until the reader scrolls away from the floor.

properties.name: loadingOlder
properties.desc: Whether a page is in flight; the affordance stays visible and goes inert.

properties.name: older
properties.desc: Label for the paging affordance above the first row. Empty hides it.

properties.name: pinned
properties.desc: Whether the view is currently following new content.

properties.name: busy
properties.desc: Whether the work this row stands for is still running.

properties.name: expandable
properties.desc: Whether the row has a body worth opening.

properties.name: heading
properties.desc: The fixed-width left half of the line.

properties.name: name
properties.desc: Groups rows so that opening one closes the rest.

properties.name: open
properties.desc: Whether the body is shown.

properties.name: summary
properties.desc: The truncating right half. Empty drops the separator with it.

properties.name: tone
properties.desc: `error` colours the summary; anything else is the ordinary tone.

properties.desc: Surface language for this panel (`glass` | `solid`). Paint is CSS-only via

properties.name: active
properties.desc: The transient cursor that pointer hover and arrow keys move; r-select sets it. It shares the hover fill and carries no selection meaning.

properties.name: selected
properties.desc: Marks the committed choice with a check mark. Unlike `active` (the transient cursor), it stays put while the cursor moves.

properties.name: spread
properties.desc: Angle in degrees between the first and last child once open. Defaults to `24`; `0` lines them up.

properties.name: backdrop
properties.desc: An `` or `

properties.name: bevel
properties.desc: Width of the curved edge band that bends light, in px.

properties.name: dispersion
properties.desc: How far the colors split at the edge, as a percentage of `displace`. `0` keeps them together.

properties.name: displace
properties.desc: How far the edge pulls the backdrop inward, in px. `0` is a flat pane.

properties.name: interactive
properties.desc: Hover lift + press-scale feedback, for clickable glass. Also makes the host

properties.name: material
properties.desc: A preset for every optical value: `regular` (default), `thin`, `thick` or `clear`.

properties.name: optics
properties.desc: The material's values with any attribute override applied.

properties.name: radius
properties.desc: Corner radius, in px.

properties.name: rim
properties.desc: Opt-in GPU specular rim: an outer and an inner wall line, lit by a key light from the

properties.name: saturate
properties.desc: Backdrop saturation, as a percentage number (e.g. `180`).

properties.name: sheen
properties.desc: Animated specular sweep across the surface.

properties.name: specular
properties.desc: Strength of the highlights, as a percentage (`100` is the material's normal light).

properties.name: tint
properties.desc: Glass fill tint (any CSS background value).

properties.name: tone
properties.desc: What sits behind the glass: `dark` (default) lights the edge, `light` shades it, because a

properties.name: alt
properties.desc: Alternative text forwarded to the inner ``. Defaults to `''` (empty),

properties.name: fallback
properties.desc: Image shown when `src` fails. Empty by default: a failed image then shows a theme-aware placeholder that fills the box.

properties.name: disabled
properties.desc: Blocks typing and focus, greys the field out and leaves it out of form validation. Off by default; `disabled="false"` counts as enabled.

properties.name: icon
properties.desc: Name of an `r-icon` shown before the text, for example `search`. No icon when unset.

properties.name: label
properties.desc: Caption rendered above the field and linked to the inner input, so it is the field's accessible name and clicking it focuses the input. No caption when unset.

properties.name: max
properties.desc: Highest accepted number. Applies only when `type` is `'number'`; larger values fail form validation.

properties.name: message
properties.desc: Helper or validation text shown below the field and linked to it with `aria-describedby`. Nothing is rendered when empty.

properties.name: min
properties.desc: Lowest accepted number. Applies only when `type` is `'number'`; smaller values fail form validation.

properties.name: name
properties.desc: Key under which the value is submitted with the owning form.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.desc: Hint text shown inside the field while it is empty.

properties.name: required
properties.desc: Makes an empty value fail native form validation (`checkValidity()`, `:invalid`) and sets `aria-required`. Off by default; setting the property to `false` or `'false'` removes it.

properties.name: status
properties.desc: Validation state: `'error'` | `'warning'`. Colours the border and label and adds a status icon; pair it with `message` so the state is not shown by colour alone. Empty (neutral) by default.

properties.name: step
properties.desc: Granularity of accepted numbers, forwarded to the native input. Applies only when `type` is `'number'`; off-step values fail form validation.

properties.name: surface
properties.desc: Surface language for this control (`glass` | `solid`). Paint is CSS-only via

properties.name: type
properties.desc: Native input type forwarded to the inner `<input>`, such as `text`, `password` or `number`; `number` enables `min`, `max` and `step`. Behaves as `text` when unset.

properties.name: validationMessage
properties.desc: The browser's message for the current constraint error; empty while the field is valid.

properties.name: validity
properties.desc: Native `ValidityState` of the field, for reading constraint errors from script. `undefined` where ElementInternals is unavailable.

properties.name: value
properties.desc: Current text of the field. Updates on every keystroke and is submitted with the owning form under `name`. Empty by default.

properties.name: label
properties.desc: Accessible name announced by the `status` role. Defaults to "Loading"; set it to say what is loading.

properties.name: caret
properties.desc: Shows a blinking caret after the last block while text streams in; remove it when the answer is complete. Any value draws a block caret; `'circle'` draws a dot.

properties.name: content
properties.desc: Markdown source. Resolution order: the `content` property (set via JS, not reflected), the `content` attribute, then the element's text content.

properties.name: copyable
properties.desc: Adds a copy button to each code block header. Reflects the `copy` attribute; off by default.

properties.name: downloadable
properties.desc: Adds a download button to each code block header that saves the code as a file. Reflects the `download` attribute; off by default.

properties.name: highlight
properties.desc: Shiki syntax highlighting for code blocks; off when the attribute is absent. `""` → github-light/github-dark; `"a"` → both; `"a b"` → light / dark theme.

properties.name: inlineMath
properties.desc: Treats `$…$` as inline math. Off by default because `$` often means currency; `\(…\)` always works. Reflects the `inline-math` attribute.

properties.name: lineNumbers
properties.desc: Shows line numbers in code blocks. Reflects the `line-numbers` attribute; off by default.

properties.name: linkTarget
properties.desc: `target` for rendered links, set with `rel="noopener noreferrer"`. Defaults to `'_blank'`; use `'_self'` to open links in place. In-page `#` links are left alone.

properties.name: mode
properties.desc: Parsing mode: `'streaming'` | `'static'`. Default `'streaming'` repairs half-written syntax and re-renders only changed blocks; use `'static'` for finished text.

properties.name: theme
properties.desc: Colour scheme: `'auto'` | `'light'` | `'dark'`. Default `'auto'` follows the document theme; embedded Mermaid diagrams use the same value.

properties.name: leaveDelay
properties.desc: Milliseconds before close after the pointer leaves the bar and panels.

properties.name: panelSelector
properties.desc: Portaled panels watched for hover leave forgiveness. Defaults to `r-dropdown.ran-chrome-menu`.

properties.name: sheet
properties.desc: CSS injected into the component's shadow DOM.

properties.name: switchHold
properties.desc: How long peer-hop CSS (zero enter/exit) stays armed, in milliseconds.

properties.name: surface
properties.desc: Surface language for this toast (`glass` | `solid`). Paint is CSS-only via

properties.name: autoFocus
properties.desc: Moves focus to the first focusable element in the dialog (or the dialog itself) when it opens. On by default; turn off with `autoFocus="false"`.

properties.name: closable
properties.desc: Shows the close button in the corner. On by default; turn off with `closable="false"` when the dialog must be closed by its own actions.

properties.name: closeOnEsc
properties.desc: Closes the topmost dialog when Escape is pressed. On by default; turn off with `closeOnEsc="false"`.

properties.name: heading
properties.desc: Heading text shown in the title bar; falls back to `Modal` when empty.

properties.name: hideHeader
properties.desc: Headerless mode for content-only dialogs such as image lightboxes: drops the title bar and keeps only a floating close button when `closable`. Off by default.

properties.name: lockScroll
properties.desc: Stops the page behind from scrolling while the dialog is open. On by default; turn off with `lockScroll="false"`.

properties.name: maskClosable
properties.desc: Closes the dialog when the backdrop outside it is clicked. On by default; turn off with `maskClosable="false"` for forms that must not be dismissed by a stray click.

properties.name: open
properties.desc: Shows the dialog when set and closes it when removed. Off by default; `open="false"` counts as closed.

properties.name: surface
properties.desc: Surface language for this dialog (`glass` | `solid`). Paint is CSS-only via

properties.name: autoplay
properties.desc: Start playback as soon as the video can play, via the native `autoplay` flag. Browsers usually block unmuted autoplay, so pair it with `muted`. Off by default.

properties.name: controllerBarTimeId
properties.desc: Internal timer id for auto-hiding the control bar. Not meant to be set by consumers.

properties.name: currentTime
properties.desc: Playback position in seconds, also accepted as `currenttime`. In the markup it is the start position; a later change seeks. The getter returns the attribute, not the live position.

properties.name: debug
properties.desc: Any non-empty value logs every internal `change` event and source-load errors to the console. An empty value (`<r-player debug>`) leaves logging off.

properties.name: disableErrorModal
properties.desc: Suppress the built-in playback-error panel with its Retry button, for apps that show their own error UI. Off by default, so the panel shows.

properties.name: format
properties.desc: Playback engine: `'hls'` | `'dash'` | `'flv'` | `'webrtc'` | `'native'`. Empty by default, which detects it from the `src` extension; set it for signed or extensionless URLs, and always for `webrtc` (a WHEP endpoint).

properties.name: labelError
properties.desc: Heading of the built-in playback-error panel. Defaults to `'Playback failed'`.

properties.name: labelRetry
properties.desc: Label of the panel's retry button. Defaults to `'Retry'`.

properties.name: loop
properties.desc: Restart from the beginning when playback ends, via the native `loop` flag. Off by default.

properties.name: moveProgress
properties.desc: Internal seek-bar drag state (`percentage`, `mouseDown`), read by the player's own modules. Not meant to be set by consumers.

properties.name: muted
properties.desc: Start silent: sets volume to 0 and the native `muted` flag. Removing the attribute restores the previous volume, or 50 if none was recorded. Off by default.

properties.name: playbackRate
properties.desc: Speed multiplier such as `1`, `1.5` or `2`, also accepted as `playbackrate`. Applied from the markup and on every change.

properties.name: poster
properties.desc: Image URL shown on the video before playback starts, passed to the native `<video poster>`.

properties.name: rememberPosition
properties.desc: Save the position to localStorage, keyed by `src`, on pause and when the page is hidden, and resume there on the next load of the same `src`. The entry is cleared when playback ends. Off by default.

properties.name: src
properties.desc: Media URL to play. The engine is picked from its extension unless `format` is set; changing it on a connected player reloads the source.

properties.name: thumbnails
properties.desc: URL of a WebVTT sprite-sheet manifest that shows a preview thumbnail above the seek-bar hover tip.

properties.name: tracks
properties.desc: Subtitle and caption tracks as `{ src, srclang, label, kind?, default? }` objects; property only, no attribute. Defaults to `[]`.

properties.name: volume
properties.desc: Volume on a 0-100 scale, clamped; `muted` wins. Applied from the markup and on every change; the getter returns the attribute, not the live volume.

properties.name: getPopupContainerId
properties.desc: Id of the element the panel is mounted into, looked up in the popover's own root first and then the document. Defaults to `document.body`.

properties.name: open
properties.desc: Whether the panel is showing.

properties.name: placement
properties.desc: Which side of the trigger the panel sits on, with an optional alignment. Defaults to `'top'`.

properties.name: trigger
properties.desc: How the panel opens: `'hover'` | `'click'`. Default `'hover'`. Click toggles the panel in either mode; hover is ignored on mobile devices.

properties.name: content
properties.desc: The reasoning text. Assigning repeatedly is the streaming path.

properties.name: duration
properties.desc: How long the model spent, in milliseconds. Rendered beside the label when set.

properties.name: label
properties.desc: Summary text. Defaults to `Reasoning`.

properties.name: open
properties.desc: Whether the body is expanded.

properties.name: streaming
properties.desc: Whether reasoning is still arriving.

properties.name: exact
properties.desc: Match only the full path, so `/users` no longer shows for `/users/42`. Off by default; set it on a `/` home route.

properties.name: params
properties.desc: Read-only. Values captured by the `:name` segments of `path` on the last match, URL-decoded. Empty when the route does not match.

properties.name: path
properties.desc: Path pattern this route shows for. `:name` segments capture params and `*` matches the rest. Without `exact`, deeper paths also match. Defaults to `'/'`.

properties.name: src
properties.desc: Module specifier for lazy, code-split, mount/unmount page rendering.

properties.name: defaultValue
properties.desc: Option value to select initially when `value` is not set; also restored by `form.reset()`. Applied once the matching option exists.

properties.name: disabled
properties.desc: Blocks opening, selection and search, removes the select from the tab order and closes an open dropdown. Off by default; `disabled="false"` counts as enabled.

properties.name: dropdownclass
properties.desc: Class name set on the dropdown panel when it is first built, so the portaled panel can be styled from outside.

properties.name: dropdownsurface
properties.desc: Surface language for the portaled dropdown panel (`glass` | `solid`).

properties.name: getPopupContainerId
properties.desc: Id of the element the dropdown panel is mounted into, looked up in the select's own root first and then the document. Defaults to `document.body`.

properties.name: label
properties.desc: Caption rendered above the field and used as its accessible name; clicking it focuses the select. No caption when unset.

properties.name: open
properties.desc: Whether the dropdown is showing.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.desc: Empty-field hint; the field's accessible name remains its label.

properties.name: placement
properties.desc: Which side of the trigger the panel opens on, with an optional alignment. Defaults to `'bottom'`.

properties.name: required
properties.desc: Makes an empty selection fail native form validation and sets `aria-required`. Ignored while disabled. Off by default; setting the property to `false` or `'false'` removes it.

properties.name: showSearch
properties.desc: Adds a search box that filters options as you type. Enabled whenever the attribute is present, whatever its value; remove the attribute to turn it off.

properties.name: trigger
properties.desc: How the dropdown opens: `'click'` | `'hover'`. Default `'click'`. Hover is ignored on mobile devices.

properties.name: type
properties.desc: Visual style. `'text'` drops the border, background and arrow so the select reads as inline text; any other value keeps the boxed field.

properties.name: validationMessage
properties.desc: The browser's message for the current constraint error; empty while the field is valid.

properties.name: validity
properties.desc: Native `ValidityState` of the field, for reading constraint errors from script. `undefined` where ElementInternals is unavailable.

properties.name: value
properties.desc: Value of the selected option, submitted with the owning form. Setting it selects the matching option; an empty value clears the selection.

properties.name: label
properties.desc: Accessible name.

properties.name: state
properties.desc: Which lifecycle step to show. Unknown values render as `idle`.

properties.name: open
properties.desc: Forwarded to the inner `r-select` so hosts (e.g. docs header hover menus) can open/close it.

properties.name: open
properties.desc: Forwarded to the inner `r-select` so hosts (e.g. docs header hover menus) can open/close it.

properties.name: value
properties.desc: Current color theme; falls back to 'system' when nothing is forced.

properties.name: label
properties.desc: Prefix for the readout. Defaults to `Context`; an empty string leaves only the counts.

properties.name: level
properties.desc: How full the window is. Derived; assigning it is overwritten on the next update.

properties.name: limit
properties.desc: Context window size in tokens. Zero or absent hides the bar and shows only counts.

properties.name: spent
properties.desc: Tokens billed across the conversation so far.

properties.name: used
properties.desc: Tokens the next request will carry — the history, not the whole conversation.

properties.name: call
properties.desc: The pending view, derived from the call's arguments.

properties.name: open
properties.desc: Whether the body is expanded.

properties.name: result
properties.desc: The completed view. Replaces the pending one once set.

properties.name: status
properties.desc: Lifecycle of the call, reflected so styling can key off it.

properties.name: activeLabel
properties.desc: Accessible cancel/stop name while capture is pending or listening.

properties.name: cancelHint
properties.desc: Replaces {@link holdHint} once the finger has slid far enough to discard.

properties.name: continuous
properties.desc: Keep listening across pauses instead of stopping at the first one. On by default; set `continuous="false"` to stop at the first pause.

properties.name: disabled
properties.desc: Disable the button so no capture can start. Off by default. Where speech recognition is unsupported the button is hidden instead, regardless of this.

properties.name: holdHint
properties.desc: Shown above the button while a finger is held down.

properties.name: label
properties.desc: Accessible name while idle.

properties.name: lang
properties.desc: Language being spoken, as a BCP 47 tag.

properties.name: listening
properties.desc: Whether a capture is running. Reflected, so `:host([listening])` can style it.

properties.name: supported
properties.desc: Whether this platform can recognize speech at all.
